services.name: Home page
services.description: A static home page built to your design, responsive on phones, tablets and desktops.

services.name: Additional page
services.description: One more static page, such as About, Services or Contact.

services.name: Prototype
services.description: A clickable site mockup made before development. Use it to review the layout and user flow, then resolve feedback before the build starts.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Sanity CMS setup
services.description: Sets up Sanity so your team can create and edit content without changing code. Includes the Studio, content types and deployment.

services.name: Content schema
services.description: Defines one CMS content type and its fields, such as a blog post, team member or product.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Visual editing
services.description: Lets editors select text or images on the live site and edit them in Sanity.

services.name: Dynamic listing page
services.description: Displays a CMS collection, such as blog posts, team members or portfolio projects. New entries appear without a code change.

services.name: Dynamic detail page
services.description: Builds the template for one entry in a CMS collection, such as a blog post, team profile or product.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Formspree contact form
services.description: Sends contact form submissions to your email through Formspree.
services.note: Requires a Formspree account. Subscription fees are separate.

services.name: Custom contact form
services.description: Builds a contact form without a form service. Stores submissions in your CMS and sends notifications through Resend.

services.name: Third-party API integration
services.description: Connects the site to an API, such as a CRM, inventory system or booking platform.
services.note: Price depends on the API and the required work.

services.name: Payment integration
services.description: Adds online payments through Stripe or another gateway, including checkout, confirmation and webhook handling.
services.note: The provider charges transaction fees separately.

services.name: Deployment
services.description: Deploys the site to its live URL, connects your domain and configures automatic deploys from code changes.

services.name: Cloudflare setup
services.description: Connects your domain to Cloudflare for CDN delivery, DDoS protection, HTTPS and DNS management.

services.name: Professional email setup
services.description: Sets up domain email through Zoho Mail, including DNS records and mailbox creation.

services.name: Transactional email
services.description: Sends emails triggered by site actions, such as form confirmations, booking receipts or password resets, through Resend.

services.name: Email template
services.description: Designs an HTML email for newsletters, notifications or receipts and tests it in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail.

services.name: On-page SEO
services.description: Adds page titles, meta descriptions, social sharing tags, canonical URLs and an XML sitemap for Google Search Console.

services.name: Structured data
services.description: Adds JSON-LD markup for eligible Google results, such as ratings, FAQs, breadcrumbs or events.

services.name: Analytics setup
services.description: Sets up Google Analytics 4 for traffic and conversions, then connects Google Search Console for indexing and search data.

services.name: Maintenance retainer
services.description: Monthly maintenance for updates, security checks, minor content fixes and priority support after launch.

services.name: Content migration
services.description: Moves text, images and documents from an existing site or platform.
services.note: Price depends on the amount and format of the content.

services.name: Extra revision round
services.description: One more round of design changes after the included revisions.

packages.name: Landing page
packages.description: A single page with a contact form, ready to launch and be found. Good for a campaign, an event or a new business.

packages.name: Business website
packages.description: A five page brochure site with your own contact form, a business email address and the SEO basics.

packages.name: Content managed website
packages.description: A site your team can edit without a developer, with a blog or listing section and visual editing.

packages.name: Online store
packages.description: A site that takes payments and sends order emails, with product pages and a branded confirmation email.

packages.name: Website care plan
packages.description: Monthly maintenance for a live site, with a revision round included for changes you want made.
